_security_field_comments.max_budget_usd: Maximum total USD spend before tasks are stopped (budget guardrail).
_security_field_comments.dpa_accepted: Whether the user has accepted the Data Processing Agreement for providers that require it.
_security_field_comments.device_fingerprint: Expected ADB device fingerprint; tasks abort if the connected device does not match.
_security_field_comments.sensitive_app_whitelist: List of package names that are allowed to be screenshotted despite sensitive heuristics.
_security_field_comments.allow_dangerous_tasks: When false, blocks tasks that match dangerous keywords (e.g., factory reset).
_security_field_comments.ssl_keyfile: Path to the TLS private key file used by the Gradio UI (must be owned by the user, not world-readable).
_security_field_comments.ssl_certfile: Path to the TLS certificate file used by the Gradio UI (must be owned by the user, not world-readable).
_security_field_comments.max_api_calls: Maximum number of LLM API calls allowed within a single task.
_security_field_comments.check_completion: Whether to run an extra completion-check API call after each action.
_security_field_comments.data_residency: Preferred data residency region (e.g., 'us' or 'eu'); affects provider endpoint selection.
_security_field_comments.api_key_scopes: Mapping of provider names to allowed API key scope names for key-rotation policies.
